clauses.signature: int lca(int u, int v, const int *up, const int *depth, int LOG, int stride)
clauses.code: int lca(int u,int v,const int*up,const int*depth,int LOG,int stride){ if(depth[u]<depth[v]){ int t=u;u=v;v=t; } int diff=depth[u]-depth[v]; for(int k=0;k<LOG;k++) if(diff&(1<<k)) u=up[(size_t)k*stride+u]; if(u==v) return u; for(int k=LOG-1;k>=0;k--){ int pu=up[(size_t)k*stride+u], pv=up[(size_t)k*stride+v]; if(pu!=pv){ u=pu; v=pv; } } return up[u]; }
